title: Diamond Bank
description: Use diamonds as a currency and safely store them
body:
This datapack adds functionality for using diamonds as a currency primarily so that players dont need to open up shulkers or ender chests and physically exchange items. Instead, this data pack adds commands to allow easier transactions. No long distance trade is implemented yet so in person trading is still encouraged.

Commands:
- /trigger deposit - deposit all diamonds in your inventory into your bank account
- /trigger deposit set 2 - automatically deposits all diamonds in your inventory to your bank account when you pick them up. Using /trigger withdraw will disable this temporarily for 60 seconds.
- /trigger balance - check how many diamonds are in your bank account
- /trigger withdraw set (value) - withdraw a certain amount of diamonds from your bank account. Has safety features to prevent diamonds from flying out of your inventory.
- /trigger pay_nearest set (value) - virtually sends diamonds to the nearest player within 8 blocks
